basic_details.job_title: Central University of Rajasthan Non Teaching Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Lower Division Clerk Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Central University of Rajasthan (CURAJ) has invited online applications from eligible Indian citizens for the Lower Division Clerk–EWS Group-C non-teaching position on a regular basis under Advertisement No. CURAJ/R./F.179/Rectt./2026/7314 dated 22.10.2026. Eligible candidates may submit their online applications through the official website www.curaj.ac.in by 10 December 2026 up to 11:59 PM, and send the printed hardcopy of the application with enclosures to the Registrar (Recruitment Cell), Central University of Rajasthan on or before 15 December 2026 up to 05:00 PM.

how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.curaj.ac.in to access the online application form in the prescribed format.
Submit the online application and pay the prescribed application fee using Credit Card, Debit Card, Net Banking, or UPI.
Take a printout of the submitted online application form.

Enclose the original online payment receipt of the prescribed application fee, photocopies of the certificate in support of Date of Birth, qualifications, experience, and category certificates (such as SC/ST/OBC/PWD) where applicable. Ensure every page of the application, annexures, and certificates are self-attested.
Pack the documents in an envelope duly superscripted “Application for the post of _________________ (Post Category)”.

Send the completed hardcopy by post to reach the following address on or before 15 December 2026 by 05:00 PM: Registrar (Recruitment Cell), Central University of Rajasthan, NH-8, Bandarsindri, Kishangarh, District - Ajmer, 305817 (Rajasthan)
important_instructions: Candidates currently employed in Central/State Government or public funded organizations must apply through proper channel or submit an advance copy before the deadline, producing a "No Objection Certificate" and vigilance clearance/disciplinary status certificate at the time of interview. Application fees are non-refundable, and separate applications must be submitted if applying for multiple posts. Candidates must bring all original testimonials and certificates during the verification stage, failing which their candidature will be cancelled. Outstation candidates belonging to SC, ST, and PWD categories attending the interview are eligible for second class rail fare or ordinary bus fare by the shortest route as per rules, excluding those already in government service. Canvassing in any form will lead to direct cancellation of candidature. The OBC certificate should be issued in the Performa prescribed by the Government of India and should not be issued before six months from the date of submission of application form and it should clearly state that the candidate does not fall under creamy layer.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential qualifications specified for the post code C-01.

rows.essential_qualification: i) Bachelor’s Degree from a recognized University/Institute with at least 50% marks or pass in Master’s Degree.ii) A typing speed of 35 words per minute in English or 30 words per minute in Hindi on Computer.iii) Knowledge of Computer Applications.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be appointed to a regular position governed by the University, UGC, and Government of India rules and regulations. The post carries a Pay Level-02 salary structure. Selected candidates will be governed by the National Pension System (earlier known as 'New Pension Scheme') of the Govt. of India as applicable w.e.f. 01.01.2004.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The university may conduct a written test, trade test, computer test, or any other test as per the requirement of the post in accordance with the Cadre Recruitment Rules (Non–Teaching), 2018. Mere possession of essential qualifications does not entitle candidates to be called for a test or interview. The university reserves the right to restrict the number of candidates to a reasonable limit on the basis of higher qualifications or experience when applications received are large in number.
